title: Disco Dream | 4BR Rooftop Sauna & Wellness Studio
description:
Boogie into a groovy 70s disco dream, four levels of Nashville style built for gathering. Four en-suite bedrooms, 4.5 baths, and a chef's kitchen keep your whole crew comfortable. Mirrored glam table. The top-floor wellness studio shines with a ballet bar, yoga mats, mirrored wall, and karaoke, opening to a rooftop deck with infrared sauna, gas fire pit, and TV. Minutes from Germantown and Broadway, tucked in a gated community with private parking. Strike a pose, then unwind.
